integrity: All 234 quadrangle columns, 66 unimodular boundary columns, exact determinant, modular ranks and Smith invariants can be reproduced from the standalone Python verifier. Certificate attests to same-model checks only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The finite PG(2,3) rank-three independence complex only; no claim of general projective-plane extension, full integral equivariant representation, or intrinsic homological 3-torsion. Related literature has residual publication-priority uncertainty.
title: An order-27 integral obstruction to quadrangle-cycle generation in the ternary projective plane
